patterns.note: Asymmetrical product groupings and full-bleed imagery are used extensively, creating a sophisticated, editorial layout that prioritizes visual storytelling over dense information.

Headings utilize a distinctive, elegant serif font (Alliance No.1) at generous sizes, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and small, uppercase labels, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.

The palette is dominated by a warm off-white background, deep charcoal text, and subtle, muted accent colors derived directly from product packaging (e.g., deep teal, warm amber), reinforcing a natural and premium feel.
Content sections, particularly large image blocks and product detail areas, subtly fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth and engaging reveal experience.
Many sections feature large, high-quality, full-bleed photographs of products or lifestyle shots, often with minimal text overlays, giving the page an immersive, magazine-like quality.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-width, high-resolution product arrangement as a background, with overlaid text and a call-to-action button that scrolls away to reveal more of the product composition, leveraging the detected video-hero capability for subtle background animation or static display.

Content sections throughout the page are revealed using scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations, causing them to subtly fade in and slide upwards as they enter the user's viewport, enhancing engagement without being distracting.
A persistent header navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing continuous access to site navigation and branding without significant transformation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Generous, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with clean, legible sans-serif body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, leaning towards sharp, with minimal rounding on elements like buttons and product packaging.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical and horizontal padding around content blocks and between sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated, editorial-style product photography and presentation, which elevates oral care products into a luxury experience. The meticulous composition of product groupings, combined with a clean, airy layout and subtle motion, creates a distinctive, high-end aesthetic that feels more like a design magazine than an e-commerce site.
